description: This PHP file defines the class Image_Graph_Grid_Bars, which is a part of the Image_Graph package used for rendering grid overlays on graphs, specifically alternating bar patterns. It extends the Image_Graph_Grid class and contains methods related to drawing grid bars on a plot area.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Grid_Bars
classes.description: A class for displaying alternating bars on a graph's plot area, used to enhance grid visualization.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Outputs the grid bars on the canvas by drawing polygons between secondary axis points, alternating their fill styles.

methods.name: _done
